vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s telling A person, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose about A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
👀 the person in their 30s, with a scarred cheek, the emt starts a story with "back when I was an EMT..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek).
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Addison, Kyle, Charlotte, Keltoum and Diana met them at the door — 5 put down. Addison, Kyle, Charlotte, Keltoum, Diana are hurt.
🛡️ Addison, Charlotte, Stefany and Keltoum met them at the door — 4 put down. Addison, Charlotte, Keltoum are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Addison, Charlotte and Victor met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Addison, Charlotte, Victor are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Addison, Victor and Lena met them at the door — 3 put down. Addison, Victor, Lena are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Keltoum just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yuki just put down The Ugly Bastard... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Addison, Victor and Lena met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Addison, Victor, Lena are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
